verdicts.reason: A keeps the diamond lockup intact and readable and sets the date beside it in a reading order that suits a banner. However, the date box floats with no grouping to the diamond, and the full-width rule lines are left as stray fragments at the far left and right. B blows the small sun/field logo up into a huge green graphic over the busy vegetable photo, which reads as a collision and distorts the brand. Its date text is also tiny and weak inside a wide white band that is mostly empty, so the date gets lost.
